      {"text": "3-AP provides a single amino group to passivate defects on the SnO2 surface.", "anchor": "3‐AP molecule with a rigid planar conjugated pyridine ring provides a single amino group (─NH 2 ) to passivate the defect on SnO 2 surface", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "5-A2FP inserts a fluorine group to polarize the interface and regulate the energy level.", "anchor": "5‐A2FP molecule inserts a fluorine group (─F) to polarize the interface and regulate the energy level", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The optimized device retains 92% efficiency after 1200 h of MPPT.", "anchor": "while retaining 92% efficiency after 1200 h of maximum power point tracking", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {

    "architecture": "p-i-n",

    "pce_champion": {"value": 25, "unit": "%", "anchor": "inverted perovskite solar cells based on Py‐4PACz achieve over 25% efficiency and exceptional operational stability"},

    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-L-3",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The flexible Py-4PACz optimizes molecular orientation and acts as an interfacial strain buffer, reducing nonradiative loss.", "anchor": "the flexible Py‐4PACz optimizes molecular orientation and allows pyrene to function as an interfacial strain buffer, significantly reducing nonradiative loss", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retain >91.2% efficiency after 700 h of MPPT.", "anchor": "retaining >91.2% efficiency after 700 h of maximum power point tracking", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retain >90% efficiency after the ISOS-L-3 damp-heat protocol.", "anchor": "and >90% following the stringent ISOS‐L‐3 damp‐heat protocol", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },

      {"text": "Two positional methylation isomers, 1-MH and 5-MH, were designed and investigated.", "anchor": "we designed and investigated two positional methylation isomers, 1-methylhydantoin (1-MH) and 5-methylhydantoin (5-MH)", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The 5-MH device retains 92% of its initial PCE after 2000 h under ISOS-L2.", "anchor": "retaining 92% of its initial PCE after 2000 h under the ISOS-L2 protocol", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

    "claims": [
      {"text": "The bicarbazole-core molecule 9,9-DCz adopts a predominantly upright orientation on ITO.", "anchor": "identify a bicarbazole‐core molecule, 9,9‐DCz, that adopts a predominantly upright orientation on indium tin oxide (ITO)", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The vertical SAM configuration yields denser coverage, favorable energy alignment, and reduced non-radiative recombination.", "anchor": "This vertical configuration facilitates denser surface coverage, favorable energy‐level alignment, and reduced non‐radiative recombination in the WBG perovskite layer.", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]

    "t80_h": null,

      {"text": "PEDOT hole transport channels are constructed in situ within the perovskite film via solid-state polymerization of DBEDOT.", "anchor": "we employ a low‐temperature solution‐processed solid‐state polymerization (SSP) method using 2,5‐dibromo‐3,4‐ethylenedioxythiophene (DBEDOT) to in situ construct poly(3,4‐ethylenedioxythiophene) (PEDOT) hole transport channels within the perovskite film.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The tandem device retains 90% of its initial efficiency after 1100 h of MPP operation at 55C.", "anchor": "the tandem device retains 90% of its initial efficiency after 1100 h of continuous operation at 55°C under maximum power point (MPP) conditions.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]

    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A site-specific halogenation strategy strengthens SAM-perovskite interactions via lattice-matched dual-site passivation.", "anchor": "we present a rational site‐specific halogenation strategy that strengthens SAM‐perovskite interactions through lattice‐matched, dual‐site passivation.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retain 95.9% of initial efficiency after 1000 h under ISOS-L-2.", "anchor": "retaining 95.9% of their initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous illumination under the ISOS‐L‐2 protocol.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

      {"text": "Devices fabricated at 70% RH still achieve a PCE of 23.24%.", "anchor": "When the PSCs are fabricated in a high‐humidity atmosphere (70% RH), the PSCs still achieve a high PCE of 23.24%.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices retain 92% of initial PCE after 180 days in air.", "anchor": "Unencapsulated devices retain 92% of their initial PCE after 180 days in air (30–40% RH).", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

      {"text": "Cyanoacetic acid is incorporated into both the SAM and the perovskite precursor for synergistic interface-bulk regulation.", "anchor": "We report a synergistic interface–bulk regulation strategy by incorporating cyanoacetic acid (CA) into both the self‐assembled monolayers (SAM) and the perovskite precursor.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The optimized 1.66-eV PSC achieves a steady-state PCE of 24.43%.", "anchor": "The optimized 1.66‐eV PSC achieves a steady‐state power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 24.43%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The tandem yields 32.43% champion PCE with 93% retention after 1000 h.", "anchor": "yields a champion PCE of 32.43% with 93% retention after 1000 h.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

      {"text": "Dipole management at Sn-Pb grain boundaries is achieved using FBH.", "anchor": "we employ dipole management at GBs of Sn‐Pb perovskite by 4‐(trifluoromethyl)benzohydrazide (FBH), which effectively modulates the GB energy landscape throughout the film.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The optimized Sn-Pb cell achieves 23.25% efficiency.", "anchor": "the optimized Sn‐Pb perovskite solar cell achieves a high efficiency of 23.25%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The tandem retains 90% of initial efficiency after about 1000 h MPPT.", "anchor": "retains 90% of its initial efficiency after approximately 1000 h maximum power point tracking.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

      {"text": "Encapsulated devices retain 96% of initial efficiency after 2000 h of MPP operation.", "anchor": "Encapsulated devices retain 96% of their initial efficiency after 2000 h of continuous maximum‐power‐point operation", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

      {"text": "Devices retain 97.8% of initial efficiency after 1000 h under ISOS-L-2I.", "anchor": "retaining 97.8% of its initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous operation under the ISOS-L-2I protocol", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

      {"text": "The hydrophobic phosphonic acid-terminated molecules act as a buried hole-transporting layer and form an ultrathin capping layer on the SnO2.", "anchor": "the phosphonic acid-terminated hydrophobic [4-(3,6-dimethyl-9H-carbazol-9-yl)butyl]phosphonic acid molecules act not only as a buried hole-transporting layer in our devices", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "WBG devices reach 20.58% PCE and retain 95% after 2500 h at 65% RH.", "anchor": "encapsulated WBG (1.77 eV) perovskite devices with a maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 20.58% retained 95% of their initial PCEs after 2500 h of storage at 65% relative humidity", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
